title: spec(system): push-config / push-device docblocks still cite ADR-0012 §6 for "domestic vendors are alternate channel plugins", the reading #29817 retires
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzfgvGexKn9vLHsy89K

Filing gate: ① a defect at named locations. The contract review of PR #29952 (#29817, the ADR-0012 amendment), records 6610988758 and 6611334981, found it and escalated it. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (comment text only, nothing an author writes changes).

Blocked-by: #29952

**Business reason.** Once PR #29952 lands, ADR-0012 §6 says the hosted relay fronts the domestic Android vendors (HMS/Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo), and that `vendor` on a device row is a token type the relay routes on, not a plugin boundary. The spec docblocks that cite §6 would then send a reader to the ADR for the opposite reading. A future card that widens `PushVendorSchema` would be told, by the schema's own comment, that the vendors belong in channel plugins. Reader: the `domain:spec` seat (`packages/spec/src/system/`).

## What the code says (at `origin/main` `6a4737ab`)

- `packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts` ≈:76: "Out of scope here: the other vendors ADR-0012 §6 routes to alternate channel plugins (HMS, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo)."
- the same file ≈:83, the `PushVendorSchema` docblock: "ADR-0012 §6 plugs the domestic Android vendors in as alternate channel implementations, not as transports of this channel".
- `packages/spec/src/system/push-device.zod.ts` ≈:12 "(ADR-0012 §6, narrowed to what core ships)" and ≈:49 "Narrowed from ADR-0012 §6: … the domestic Android vendors plug in as alternate channel implementations".
- `packages/spec/src/api/register-device-request.test.ts` ≈:8: "alternate channel plugins (ADR-0012 §6)".

## Wanted

- Rewrite those comments to the amended §6 / §6.1 reading. Core ships `apns | fcm`. The relay fronts the domestic vendors in phase 2, and `vendor` is the token type it routes on. Widening `PushVendorSchema` remains a spec change made together with the relay's vendor support.
- Comment text only: no schema, `.describe()`, export or default moves. Measure whether any generated reference page carries these docblocks; if one does, regenerate it.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, and a changeset only if the gate asks for one.

Serial: after PR #29952 merges (Tier H; the maintainer merges it), so the comments never cite a §6 that main does not have. Seat 2's #29820 also edits push-config.zod.ts (the transport-selection docblock and markers). Expect a trivial merge at most.

Dedupe: searched `PushVendorSchema`, `push vendor relay`, `alternate channel`. Found #29817 (the ADR, which carries no code), #29820 (scope: token, key, reader), and #29920 (the relay sender). **New.**
